title: GTA 6 Developer Rockstar Games Doubled in Size and Hired Real Professionals
description: Rockstar Games doubled its employee headcount for GTA 6 and hired real-world professionals for vehicles, fashion, and more, according to IGN.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Games Scales Up: GTA 6 Development Team Doubled in Size

As anticipation continues to build across the gaming community, new details regarding the development scale of Grand Theft Auto 6 have emerged. According to reports from IGN, Rockstar Games doubled its employee headcount specifically for the development of GTA 6, highlighting the massive scope and ambition behind the upcoming open-world title.

## Bringing Real-World Expertise to Vice City and Beyond

Expanding the workforce was not merely about increasing headcounts. Rockstar Games went a step further by hiring real-world professionals to work on key aspects of the game. According to the available details, these industry experts were brought in to shape several core components of the virtual world:

* **Vehicles:** Professionals from the real-world automotive sector contributed to the design, ensuring that the cars and transportation in the game reflect a high degree of authenticity.
* **Fashion:** Real-world fashion industry experts helped craft the clothing styles, street trends, and overall aesthetic wardrobe found within the game.
* **Additional Elements:** The integration of specialized professionals extends into other areas, reinforcing the studio's commitment to detail.

## Industry Context and Development Scope

Looking at the scale of modern AAA game development, doubling a studio's size for a single project is a monumental undertaking. Past titles in the franchise have continually pushed technical boundaries, and the decision to onboard external specialists for vehicles and fashion suggests that Rockstar is aiming for an unprecedented level of realism in its next virtual playground. Observers note that this strategy aligns with the studio's historical dedication to capturing and satirizing real-world culture through meticulous detail.

## Editor's Take

Doubling the development team and recruiting real-world professionals demonstrates Rockstar's unwavering commitment to making GTA 6 a milestone in gaming history. By bridging the gap between video game development and real-world fashion and automotive industries, the studio is setting a new benchmark for environmental storytelling and immersion in open-world games.
